label: Day 1
title: Discovery Call
desc: We discuss your requirements, timeline, and technical constraints. ask the right questions so we both know exactly what's being built before anything else happens.

label: Day 2–3
title: Proposal + MOU
desc: I send a written proposal with fixed scope, timeline, and price. Once we agree, we sign a simple MOU. The 50% deposit is paid and work begins.

label: During Project
title: Build + Progress Updates
desc: I send progress updates at least twice a week. You can reach me on WhatsApp or email anytime. No disappearing mid-project.

label: End of Project
title: Delivery + Handover
desc: Full source code, documentation, and deployment. You pay the remaining 50%. I stay available for 14 days post-handover to fix any bugs in the delivered code.
